name: get_standings
description: Check current NHL standings. Returns wins, losses, OT losses, points, goals for/against, and streak info for all teams.

name: get_scores
description: Get today's NHL game scores and status (live, final, or scheduled). Returns teams, scores, shots on goal, and current period.

name: get_schedule
description: Get the current NHL weekly schedule. Returns upcoming and recent games with teams, dates, times, and venues.

name: get_player
description: Get an NHL player's profile and current season stats by player ID. Returns bio, position, team, and season statistics.

playerId.description: NHL player ID (e.g., 8478402 for Connor McDavid)
